title: Hippos Ooze a Red Liquid That Works as Natural Sunscreen
subject: hippo

scenes.text: Hippos ooze red liquid. It's secretly a sunscreen.
People call it blood sweat. It isn't blood, and it isn't really sweat.
It starts out colorless, then turns red-orange within minutes, and later darkens to brown.
Japanese scientists found two pigments in it, hipposudoric acid and norhipposudoric acid.
Both absorb ultraviolet light. One red pigment also slowed the growth of two disease-causing bacteria in lab tests.
So a hippo isn't bleeding. It's wearing sunscreen and antibiotic.
